name: Oran's Gratitude
label: Quest
description: After Rin'ji's Secret, the chain that began with Rin'ji is Trapped! comes to its close with Oran Snakewrithe, to whom you bring a tablet.
intro: After Rin'ji's Secret, the chain that began with Rin'ji is Trapped! comes to its close with Oran Snakewrithe, to whom you bring a tablet.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now isn't this interesting? You say you found this tablet on a small, deserted island at The Overlook Cliffs in The Hinterlands, adventurer? Very interesting indeed. Oran carefully puts the tablet away and rubs her hands together.
I thank you for your efforts in this matter. Our Dark Lady shall be very pleased with this discovery. Here, allow me to reward you proportionately.
